usage: generator.py [-h] [--difficulty {easy,moderate,hard,all}] [--seed SEED]
                    [--count COUNT] [--template TEMPLATE] [--profile PROFILE]
                    [--format {markdown,json}]

Integration by parts of a linear factor and an exponential; basis 7124. Each
source bank is an explicit empirical replay profile. These parameterized
expression patterns do not establish historical distractor intent and are
never default banks. Defaults select a complete operation-based bank before
sampling. No plots, no database writes. All answers are whole primitives
followed by +C.

  --difficulty {easy,moderate,hard,all}
  --seed SEED
  --count COUNT
  --template TEMPLATE
  --profile PROFILE
  --format {markdown,json}
